author: Xuph
body:
Apollo 13 by Xuph, imryaan, Bloodoh



This map is for the dev_revs' CTW contest.

Map features:
- Red vs Blue
- 2 Wool rooms per team
- Wahiz layouted map - due to high demand of Wahiz (might bring back actual Wahiz soon if people want it)
- Space themed
- Water in the spawndrop is not a full water block, so unlike Wahiz - you won't be able to abuse it and take the water with a bucket from the spawndrop
- 2 Bedrock walls in lane, one tunnelable and one is not
- Water in mid-side islands

Loadout: 



This map was made for competitive and designed for it, but you can put it on public if you would like to.

Screenshots (normal): http://imgur.com/a/ThL82

Screenshots (shaders): http://imgur.com/a/UhTA4

XML (thanks to Fouled): https://pastebin.com/GhKn5Rd5

Download (thanks to Mehrp): http://www.mediafire.com/file/s2qlrbr3pzovt21/Apollo_13.rar

Feedback is appreciated.
